svg.aria-label: Noisy latents and captions enter two encoders. A similarity matrix with a pale blue diagonal feeds a contrastive loss. Only the image encoder is tuned.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Training pulls each noisy latent toward its own caption
the diagonal holds each latent with its own caption
The paper fine-tunes on 50,000 latents in batches of 128, for 10 epochs (p. 8).
Its loss treats every other caption in the batch as a wrong one (p. 6).
The released script loads ready-made inputs and draws no step itself.
